messages:
alex (gtm): Quick sync — need to lock Q3 GTM playbook by EOD Friday. Focus: PLG experiments slate, sales targets, enablement timeline, and how we handle 3 high-priority customer asks. Who's on?

maria (product): I can start: customer asks = (1) support for single-tenant redwood-private onboarding checklist, (2) extra model quantization guidance for finance customers, (3) SSO + stricter audit logs. All flagged by AE for potential Dedicated deal.

jamal (sales): +1 on priority list. For Q3 quota planning we aiming for $3.2M new ARR from PLG-led expansion + $1.1M from enterprise Dedicated upsells. Targets need clear enablement collateral.

sophie (growth): PLG experiments we recommended: 1) trial to paid funnel tweak (reduce friction on credit capture), 2) in-product enablement nudge for embedding use-cases, 3) gated demo for high-usage accounts. Each experiment should have a hypothesis + metric.

eric (eng): FYI: Eng capacity between 7/10–8/20 limited due to runtime upgrade. Can take one small feature (SSO audit logs prototype) and partner on docs. Quantization guidance doc is ok as a PR with a follow-on deep-dive.

lisa (solutions): For enablement, we can ship a one-pager + 30-min playbook webinar 2 weeks after release. Need product-approved FAQ and 3 customer facing templates.

alex (gtm): Sounds good. Propose freeze scope for GTM launch: core deliverables = docs + webinar + playbook + canary rollout for 10 pilot customers. Defer full Dedicated onboarding flows to Q4 unless sales needs make it mandatory. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jamal (sales): We have two pilot deals that will ask for early Dedicated onboarding. If we defer, we risk ~$250k ARR slipping. Can we do a minimal path: "pilot onboarding kit" (checklist + 1x dev hours)?

maria (product): We can do a pilot kit. Scope: checklist, sample infra diagram, and a step-by-step for key ops tasks. No full automation. Owner: maria.

eric (eng): Ok for pilot kit. We can allocate 2 SWEs for 2 weeks + on-call during pilot. Owner: eric.

sophie (growth): Experiment slate + metric table (rough):
```
- Trial->paid funnel tweak: metric = trial->paid % within 30d, target +2.5 ppt
- In-product embedding nudge: metric = embeddings API adoption, target +15% DAU use
- Gated demo: metric = demo->paid conversion, target +5 ppt for high-touch
```
We should A/B test the credit capture flow first.

nate (revops): Need concrete launch criteria for finance to model ramp. Minimal launch criteria: 1) Docs published, 2) Pilot kit available, 3) Webinar scheduled, 4) 99% of release blockers closed, 5) support runbook updated. We'll need timestamps for each.

alex (gtm): Agree. Proposed timeline: freeze scope Tue, final QA Wed, docs + pilot kit ready Thu, webinar Fri week-of, canary rollout next Mon. Is that realistic?

eric (eng): Tight. Move QA to Fri and canary to following Tue to give us buffer.

maria (product): I'll deliver checklist + FAQ by Thu 3pm. Will post PR in docs channel.

lisa (solutions): I'll draft the playbook and 30-min webinar deck by Fri EOD. Need product review Wed.

jamal (sales): I'll secure the two pilot customers and confirm expectation of 2 dev hours support.

sophie (growth): I'll schedule the A/B experiment and prep tracking specs with analytics. Need dev flag for credit-capture test.

nate (revops): I'll update the GTM launch calendar and model revenue impact assuming no Dedicated full onboard until Q4.

alex (gtm): Decisions captured:
- Scope freeze: YES (pilot kit only; full Dedicated flows deferred)
- Owners: maria (pilot kit), eric (eng for pilot), lisa (enablement), jamal (pilot customers), sophie (experiments), nate (revops)
- Launch criteria: docs, pilot kit, webinar, support runbook, blockers resolved
- Timeline: deliverables by Fri, canary early next week (adjust if blockers)

alex (gtm): Action items assigned. Please add blockers as thread replies and update PR links. We'll reconvene Wednesday 10am if anything slips. :thumbsup:

release-bot: deploy-notification — docs-site updated: /guides/pilot-kit (deployment id: rwd-20230714-22)

eric (eng): deployed staging runbook and left TODO for SSO prototype in issue #432.

maria (product): PR: https://git.internal/docs/pilot-kit/pull/12 — added checklist + sample diagram. @lisa please review the language.

lisa (solutions): Reviewing now. Small wording tweaks, posting comments.

jamal (sales): Confirmed pilots: Acme Fintech & ClearRetail. Both okay with pilot kit + 2 dev hours.

alex (gtm): Great progress. If no objections, I'll update the roadmap doc and send to execs tomorrow morning.

sophie (growth): No objections. Will share experiment tracking sheet by EOD.

nate (revops): All set from me.

alex (gtm): Thanks everyone — closing thread.
